title: Establish the Guard genesis seed, GitHub platform certification and trusted-base workflow (V4-TODO-008 T6)
goal: Bootstrap the first trusted V4 base in von12549/Guard from the migration branch through an operator-accepted genesis seed, obtain exact-commit Linux-complete and Windows-full platform certification on GitHub runners, and then activate base-owned trusted-base verdicts for all later changes.
acceptanceCriteria: The migration branch is pushed and reviewed through a PR to main without any candidate-supplied workflow.
A workflow_dispatch-only certification workflow committed separately on main certifies the exact PR head on Linux (complete) and Windows (full) with one matching packageHash.
The seed is merged into main only after operator acceptance of the recorded evidence, making main the first trusted Guard base.
The trusted-base PR workflow is activated on main from the inactive specimen with branch and path-filter changes only, so later verdicts come from the base-owned runner.
No secrets, content-write permissions, rulesets, tags or releases are introduced by this Plan.
risks: A candidate-supplied workflow could judge its own change.
Certification on GitHub runners could diverge from the local package identity.
Activating the PR workflow before the seed is accepted would give an untrusted base judging authority.
decisions: Amendment A3: the migration PR is a genesis seed accepted by the operator on recorded evidence; trusted-base CI verdicts apply from the first post-seed change.
Keep ci-contract targetBranch and schema constants unchanged; the runner does not read targetBranch and workflows are outside package authority.
Commit the certification and trusted-base workflows directly on main as separate operator-authorized commits, never inside a candidate PR.
Merge the seed with a merge commit after certification of the exact PR head.
